ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: <SmartSectionsPanel /> was referenced at line 180 without an import statement, throwing ReferenceError and blanking the entire /maker/dashboard#sections tab (both manual AND smart sections became unusable). Added `import SmartSectionsPanel from './SmartSectionsPanel';` — verified fix restores the panel and all 9 toggles + Pick products flow.

action_items: Verify the StoreSectionsTab.jsx SmartSectionsPanel import fix is acceptable (single-line change). The bug would have blocked ALL Phase 3 UI functionality for makers even though the backend was 100% healthy.
Consider a build-time lint rule (react/jsx-no-undef is default in CRA but only fires on `eslint-plugin-react` — verify eslint config catches this in CI so identical regressions can't ship).
critical_code_review_comments: StoreSectionsTab.jsx L180 referenced <SmartSectionsPanel /> without importing it — root cause of the ReferenceError blackout. Fixed by adding the import; recommend the main agent add a CI lint check.
store_analytics.py `_ranges()` correctly excludes the current partial day (end = yesterday) — verified via `range.end < today.isoformat()` in tests. Good.

store_analytics.py `_orders_revenue()` returns unique-tx count via `sec_orders_sessions.add(li['tx_at'])` where tx_at is the timestamp. Two orders with identical created_at strings (rare but possible in seed/test data) would be counted as ONE order attributed to the section. Consider using tx `_id` or a unique tx marker instead of created_at. Non-blocking with real timestamps but a latent correctness risk.

store_analytics.py `_ai_summary()` cache key is (maker_slug, days) — but recommendations for the same maker across different `days` params could reuse each other's cache if facts_hash coincidentally matches. Cache is keyed correctly so this is fine.

smart_sections.py `enabled_smart_sections()` suppresses smart keys colliding with manual slugs — good. But the maker-facing GET does not do this suppression, so a maker who names a manual section 'new-arrivals' would see both in the manager UI but only manual on storefront. Consider surfacing a conflict indicator to the maker.
store_events.py L57 `_is_bot` is a substring match. 'headless' UA matcher would also match user-agents like 'HeadlessCheck/1.0' — negligible in practice.
MarketplaceTrendsTab.jsx defaults to 7d based on the UI screenshot (highlighted `7d` pill) but the spec says '?days=30' — cosmetic; range works when clicked. Verify intended default vs. spec.
AnalyticsTab.jsx range persistence uses localStorage — private/incognito sessions reset each visit. Acceptable for a maker's own device.

rca of the issue: Smart Sections manager blackout: /app/frontend/src/pages/MakerDashboard/StoreSectionsTab.jsx references <SmartSectionsPanel /> at line 180 but never imports it. React threw 'SmartSectionsPanel is not defined' and unmounted the entire #sections tab, so both the existing manual sections list AND the new smart-sections panel disappeared. Reproduction: sign in as a maker → open /maker/dashboard#sections → observe the CRA runtime overlay. Fix: `import SmartSectionsPanel from './SmartSectionsPanel';` in StoreSectionsTab.jsx (same directory). Applied and verified. This is a straightforward missing-import bug — CRA/eslint should have flagged it at build time; suggest checking why the react/jsx-no-undef rule didn't warn.
